content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Owns one MLB baseball franchise and its ballpark plus real estate leasing; a sports team rather than a concert promoter, ticketing platform or multi-artist venue operator."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Radio broadcasting and podcasts monetized through advertising; it does not promote concerts or sell event tickets as its core business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Bowling and arcade entertainment centers selling play time; a leisure venue model without concert promotion or artist-driven live events."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Owns major live entertainment venues hosting concerts and shows, sells event tickets and provides event production, matching Live Nation's venue and ticketing model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Online gambling, sportsbook and casino operator; regulated betting business with no live event promotion or ticketing for artists."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Advertising agency network selling creative, media buying and PR to brands; a marketing services business, not live events."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Guided tours, lodges and attractions at national park destinations; travel and hospitality rather than concert promotion or live music events."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Casino resorts earning gaming, hotel and dining revenue in Las Vegas; gaming-led hospitality, not event promotion or ticket sales for artists."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Digital and print publishing earning advertising, sponsored content and affiliate commissions; a media business with no live events."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Movie theatres and hotels serving moviegoers and travelers; film exhibition and hospitality differ from concert promotion and live music events."}]}
